segments.say: A thousand-year-old dragon just turned human, tripped, and crashed through the *floor*.
Meet Murakhan, the guardian dragon who slept under Storm Castle for a thousand *years*.
Now he serves Jin Runcandel, a nine-year-old boy with a grown man's *memories*.
Murakhan lounges around eating pastries while Jin studies *books*.
He promises to tail Jin in secret, so nobody will ever *notice*.
One night, Jin is asleep at the inn, when a loud *meow* wakes him.
A black cat is scratching at the *window*.
Jin opens it, and the cat stares right back. It is *Murakhan*.
Then the cat pops into human form, trips, and crashes through the *floor*.
Gilly slams the door open. How dare you attack the young *master*!
Her eyes glow red. Speak, before I shred you into a million *pieces*!
The dragon stares at her. Gilly? Did you say *Gilly*?
He is about to call her something she will never *forget*.
And Gilly is about to shred a *dragon*.
The full story is on our channel.
